reader_summary.overview: Robert Leonard talks with Howard Marks to discuss the future of financing small businesses. Marks is the co-founder and CEO of StartEngine, a leading equity crowdfunding platform that allows people to invest in startups and raise capital through crowds. He started out as the founder and CEO of Acclaim Games, a publisher of online games now part of The Walt Disney Company.

key_points.text: IN THIS EPISODE, YOU’LL LEARN 00:00 - Intro 03:58 - Business challenges and lessons from Activision, Acclaim Games, and StartEngine.
